scope: Bounded local feasibility test of a frozen low-rank conditional-field Gauss-Newton metric on previously inspected dataset 203; not a chain or calibration test
metric: Per ensemble: equal average of J^T W J / variance over the three fixed source states; unit white-prior precision added. Scalars and references remain fixed. M_beta=I+beta K.
limits: Same data and saved states used to build and probe a fixed candidate; exploratory in-sample feasibility only
Full Gaussian-prior dimension preserved; low-rank metric changes kinetic energy only
Six active-field projection jump metrics, not full-white motion or ESS
Conditional-field preconditioning does not include joint scalar cross blocks
No state-dependent metric, adaptation, changed posterior, prior, filter or temperature target
Rank-bounded operator storage is O(rank*dimension); exact small-reference construction is not a production sketch or distributed builder
No full-chain mixing or nonlinear calibration claim; a separate frozen chain test is required if this screen passes
